## Spec compliance

✅ All four current acceptance criteria are satisfied. Current `bd show super-plan-ufz.30 --json` and `bd comments super-plan-ufz.30` were read before reviewing the package; no comments or amendments exist. Frozen task 27 and current bead agree.

- Markdown line 7 and JSON summary[3], simulation.verdict/qualification consistently distinguish the 17h58m model-only minimum from the observed 17h43m graph window. The 903,057 ms excess is explicit; no historical lower-bound or categorical chain-cause claim remains.
- Markdown Schedule model and JSON simulation.qualification state .14 dispatch 2026-10-17T08:19:58.131Z before .20 creation 2026-10-17T08:27:13.000Z, unknown readiness/waits, residual-edge assumptions and unknown historical enforcement. They explicitly decline historical-dependency and pre-creation-wait inference.
- The 14h26m wait, 83% no-agent occupancy, 5m planning context and separate all-agent/task-slot scopes remain. Cause and task-parallelism remedy remain unestablished. What-if reductions are model-relative estimates.
- Only the two named historical profile files changed. All changed JSON leaves are interpretation strings or the new qualification; no numeric or raw subtree hunk exists. Retained source-bound comparison reports 1,818 unchanged numeric leaves, 22 unchanged complete raw subtrees, unchanged diagnosis timings/simulation results, and byte-identical Markdown raw sections/timeline. No historical results/snapshot or profiler source changes are present.

No ⚠️ items.
